selected_evidence.requirement: Prove the lock actually prevents curl from being updated
selected_evidence.summary: A full dry-run system update shows 210 packages (including libcurl) would upgrade, but the curl package itself is excluded from the transaction, confirming the versionlock is effective.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 15443601-befc-4fc4-aa76-b417968ad3f9, uptime-since 09:40:53, curl version, and active versionlock list before reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: restart acknowledgement and node unavailable during reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent polls show connection reset while node1 was rebooting.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: changed boot identity and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Exec became available again; boot_id changed to a63b64e3-a5a8-4fd8-b8d5-4bb7a6d7e3f1 and uptime-since advanced to 09:41:54, proving a real restart. Post-restart curl remains 7.76.1-31.el9 and the versionlock entry persisted, confirming the hold survives the restart.
